title: xray-health-exporter values
description: Prometheus exporter for Xray-core tunnel health

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name (used in resource naming).

fullnameOverride.description: Fully override the generated release name.

replicaCount.description: Number of replicas. Values >1 force-enable leaderElection so only one pod publishes tunnel metrics.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to v<chart appVersion> when empty.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations applied to every Deployment pod.

podLabels.description: Extra labels applied to every Deployment pod.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context (non-root, matches upstream UID 10001).

securityContext.description: Container-level security context (read-only rootfs, no privilege escalation).

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the exporter container.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables (list of {name, value} or {name, valueFrom}).

env.description: Built-in environment variables consumed by the exporter binary.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Exporter log level. Both warn and warning are accepted. Replaces the deprecated DEBUG=true flag.

CHECK_METHOD.description: Default health-check method when a tunnel omits check_method.

IP_CHECK_URL.description: IP-echo URL for the ip check method.

DOWNLOAD_URL.description: File URL for the download check method.

DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for the download check method (Go duration).

DOWNLOAD_MIN_SIZE.description: Minimum downloaded bytes for the download method to succeed.

RUN_ONCE.description: One-shot mode. true runs a single check cycle and exits.

enabled.description: Enable leader election so only one replica publishes xray_tunnel_*. Forced on when replicaCount > 1.

leaseName.description: Lease object name. Defaults to the release fullname.

create.description: Create the Role + RoleBinding granting access to coordination.k8s.io/leases.
Create a dedicated ServiceAccount for the Deployment.

name.description: ServiceAccount name. Defaults to release fullname when empty.

config.description: Exporter YAML config (rendered into a ConfigMap and mounted at /app/config.yaml).

defaults.description: Global tunnel-check defaults applied when an entry omits the field.

check_url.description: Default URL checked for tunnel health.

max_backoff.description: Maximum interval between checks after repeated failures (Go duration).

backoff_multiplier.description: Exponential backoff growth factor after failures.

check_method.description: Default check method (v1.6.0+): http, ip, or download.

ip_check_url.description: Default IP-echo URL for the ip method.

download_url.description: Default file URL for the download method.

download_timeout.description: Default timeout for the download method (Go duration).

download_min_size.description: Default minimum downloaded bytes for the download method.

subscriptions.description: Subscription URLs that auto-discover tunnels. WARNING: subscription URLs typically embed access tokens — rendered into a plain ConfigMap. Use existingConfigSecret to source config.yaml from a Secret instead.

tunnels.description: Static tunnels. Each entry needs either url (a VLESS share link) or xray_config_file.

existingConfigSecret.description: Mount an existing Secret containing config.yaml instead of rendering one from .Values.config.

metricsBasicAuth.description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth on the /metrics endpoint (upstream v1.6.0+). Auto-injects matching credentials into the ServiceMonitor when enabled together with metrics.serviceMonitor.enabled.

username.description: Username. Defaults to upstream's metricsUser when empty.

existingSecret.description: Use an existing Secret instead of a chart-generated one. Must contain both username and password keys in the ServiceMonitor's namespace.

secretName.description: Name override for the chart-generated Basic Auth Secret. Ignored when existingSecret is set.

usernameKey.description: Key inside the Secret holding the username (default username).

passwordKey.description: Key inside the Secret holding the password (default password).

metricsPush.description: Optional Pushgateway push (upstream v1.6.0+). Complementary to the /metrics pull endpoint; only the leader pushes.

url.description: Full Pushgateway URL. Avoid embedding credentials here (use urlSecret); they would land in the rendered Deployment in plaintext. Empty disables push.

urlSecret.description: Reference an existing Secret holding the full Pushgateway URL. Takes precedence over url and keeps credentials out of rendered manifests.

name.description: Name of the Secret holding the Pushgateway URL.

instance.description: Value of the instance grouping label for pushed metrics.

enabled.description: Create a Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor for the exporter.

namespace.description: Namespace for the ServiceMonitor. Defaults to the release namespace.

enabled.description: Create a PrometheusRule with default tunnel alerts.

rules.description: Override the default rule list. When empty the chart ships defaults (XrayTunnelDown, XrayHighLatency, XrayNoRecentCheck).

ingress.description: Extra ingress rules. When unset, allows ingress from any pod with label app.kubernetes.io/name: prometheus.

egress.description: Extra egress rules. When unset, allows all egress.

minAvailable.description: Minimum number of pods that must be available during disruptions.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number of pods that can be unavailable during disruptions. Takes precedence over minAvailable when set.
